select total, mastered, today_completed_new, today_completed_review, pending_new, pending_review, pending_new + pending_review as pending_total from ( select total, mastered, today_completed_new, today_completed_review, least(greatest(#{newCardsLimit} - today_completed_new, 0), new_count) as pending_new, pending_review from ( select count(1) as total, coalesce(sum(case when card_state = 'new' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as new_count, coalesce(sum(case when mastered_ready = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as mastered, coalesce(sum(case when first_learned_date = #{today} then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today_completed_new, coalesce(sum(case when first_learned_date < #{today} and reviewed_today = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as today_completed_review, coalesce(sum(case when review_due = 1 or new_direction_pending = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pending_review from ( select c.id, case when count(cp.id) > 0 and count(distinct case when cp.mastered_at is not null then cp.direction end) = 2 then 'mastered' when count(cp.id) = 0 or sum(case when cp.state = 'new' then 1 else 0 end) = count(cp.id) then 'new' else 'learning' end as card_state, case when count(cp.id) > 0 and count(distinct case when cp.mastered_at is not null then cp.direction end) = 2 then 1 else 0 end as mastered_ready, min(cp.first_learned_date) as first_learned_date, max(case when cp.last_review_date = #{today} then 1 else 0 end) as reviewed_today, max(case when cp.state not in ('new', 'mastered', 'graduated') and cp.last_review_date is not null and cp.next_review_date is not null and cp.next_review_date <= #{today} then 1 else 0 end) as review_due, case when sum(case when cp.state = 'new' then 1 else 0 end) > 0 and sum(case when cp.state not in ('new', 'mastered', 'graduated') then 1 else 0 end) > 0 then 1 else 0 end as new_direction_pending from pw_card c left join pw_card_progress cp on cp.card_id = c.id and cp.user_id = #{userId} where c.deck_id = #{deckId} and c.deleted = 0 group by c.id ) card_state_rows ) aggregate_rows ) pending_rows

select c.id, c.side_a, c.side_b, coalesce(sum(cp.reps), 0) as reps from pw_card c left join pw_card_progress cp on cp.card_id = c.id and cp.user_id = #{userId} where c.deck_id = #{deckId} and c.deleted = 0 group by c.id, c.side_a, c.side_b, c.created_at having coalesce(sum(cp.reps), 0) > 0 order by reps desc, c.created_at asc, c.id asc limit #{limit}
select id, deck_id, side_a, side_b, created_at, updated_at, deleted from pw_card where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1
